repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
repos.summary_en: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
repos.summary_zh: ArchiveBox 是一款开源自托管网页存档工具，支持从浏览器书签、历史记录、Pocket、Pinboard 等多源导入 URL，完整保存 HTML、JS、PDF、媒体文件等内容。采用标准化格式（WARC、SQLite、JSON）确保数据长期可读，提供 CLI、REST API 和 Webhook 集成能力。适用于个人知识管理、企业证据保全及数字资产备份，支持 Docker 快速部署。
repos.summary_en: ArchiveBox is an open-source self-hosted web archiving solution that preserves web content from URLs, browser history, bookmarks, Pocket, Pinboard, and more. It captures comprehensive snapshots including HTML, JavaScript, PDFs, and media files in standardized formats (WARC, SQLite, JSON) ensuring long-term accessibility. The tool offers CLI, REST API, and webhook integrations for automation, with Docker support for easy deployment. Ideal for personal knowledge management, legal evidence preservation, and social media backup, it gives users full control over their archived data.

repos.description: A modern ebook manager and reader with sync and backup capacities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web
repos.summary_zh: Koodo Reader 是一款开源的跨平台电子书阅读管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 全平台。核心亮点包括：支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等 15+ 格式，集成 OneDrive、Google Drive 等 10+ 云存储实现数据同步，内置 AI 词典翻译与文本朗读功能，提供丰富的阅读自定义选项，是个人数字阅读管理的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Koodo Reader is an open-source, cross-platform ebook management and reading application supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Key features include: compatibility with 15+ formats including EPUB, PDF, and MOBI; seamless synchronization via 10+ cloud services like OneDrive and Google Drive; integrated AI-powered dictionary, translation and text-to-speech; extensive customization for fonts, themes and layouts. It provides a comprehensive solution for personal digital reading management across all devices.

repos.description: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
repos.summary_zh: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
repos.summary_en: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

repos.description: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
repos.summary_zh: calibre 是一款功能全面的电子书管理工具，支持主流格式查看、转换、编辑与编目。其核心优势在于强大的格式转换引擎、跨平台兼容性（Linux/Windows/macOS）、设备同步能力，以及自动抓取元数据和将新闻转换为电子书的功能，是构建个人数字图书馆的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: calibre is a comprehensive e-book management suite offering viewing, conversion, editing, and cataloging across major formats. Key strengths include a powerful conversion engine, cross-platform support (Linux/Windows/macOS), device synchronization, automated metadata fetching, and news-to-ebook conversion capabilities, making it ideal for personal digital library management.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的电子书清单（多个学科，含下载链接）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是'编程随想'博主整理的跨学科电子书库，涵盖政治、技术等多个领域。核心亮点在于采用Resilio Sync P2P技术实现去中心化分发，支持免翻墙自动同步，规避审查与流量限制。提供PDF/EPUB/MOBI等全格式支持，并附带详细的阅读技术指南，构建了一个抗审查的数字知识分发体系。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts cross-disciplinary e-books curated by 'ProgramThink', covering politics, technology, and more. Its core innovation leverages Resilio Sync P2P technology for decentralized distribution, enabling censorship-resistant, auto-syncing downloads without VPN. It provides comprehensive format support (PDF/EPUB/MOBI) and detailed technical guides, forming a robust anti-censorship digital knowledge dissemination system.

repos.description: Make bilingual epub books Using AI translate
repos.summary_zh: bilingual_book_maker 是一款基于 AI 的电子书双语翻译工具，支持 epub/txt/pdf/srt 格式。核心亮点包括：集成 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini 等多款大模型，通过 litellm 统一管理非 OpenAI 模型；支持上下文感知翻译保持语义连贯；自动在多模型间负载均衡规避速率限制；提供 CLI 命令行工具，专为公版书设计，避免版权风险。
repos.summary_en: bilingual_book_maker is an AI-powered tool for creating bilingual e-books from epub/txt/pdf/srt files. Key features: integrates multiple LLMs including GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini via litellm for unified non-OpenAI model management; context-aware translation preserves semantic coherence across paragraphs; automatic load balancing across models prevents rate limiting and optimizes API costs; provides CLI for batch processing; specifically designed for public domain works to avoid copyright infringement risks while supporting parallel API keys.

repos.description: Generate audiobooks from e-books
repos.summary_zh: audiblez 利用 Kokoro-82M 高质量语音合成模型，将 EPUB 电子书自动转换为 M4B 有声书。支持中英法等9种语言，提供命令行与图形界面，跨平台运行。GPU 加速下5分钟完成《动物农场》转换，是个人制作无障碍阅读内容的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: Audiblez converts EPUB e-books to M4B audiobooks using Kokoro-82M TTS model. Supporting 9 languages including Chinese and English, it offers CLI/GUI interfaces with cross-platform compatibility. With GPU acceleration, it processes 160K characters in 5 minutes, ideal for creating accessible content.

repos.description: PDF craft can convert PDF files into various other formats. This project will focus on processing PDF files of scanned books.
repos.summary_zh: PDF Craft 是基于 DeepSeek OCR 的本地 PDF 转换工具，专注于扫描书籍的数字化处理。支持 GPU 加速，可将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或 EPUB 格式，自动识别文档结构、提取正文、过滤页眉页脚，并正确处理表格、公式和脚注。v1.0.0 后完全本地化，无需网络请求，性能显著提升。
repos.summary_en: PDF Craft is a high-performance local PDF conversion tool built on DeepSeek OCR technology, specifically designed for digitizing scanned books and documents. The tool leverages GPU acceleration to efficiently convert PDF files into structured Markdown or EPUB formats while preserving document integrity. Key features include automatic document structure recognition, intelligent extraction of main text content, removal of interfering elements like headers and footers, and proper handling of complex elements such as tables, mathematical formulas, and footnotes. Starting from version 1.0.0, PDF Craft operates entirely offline without network dependencies, eliminating previous limitations of LLM-based text correction while delivering substantially improved conversion speed and reliability for academic and technical documents.

repos.description: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
repos.summary_zh: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
repos.summary_en: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

repos.description: 《大语言模型》作者：赵鑫，李军毅，周昆，唐天一，文继荣
repos.summary_zh: 本书系统阐述大语言模型技术体系，涵盖预训练、微调、对齐及提示工程等核心内容。基于作者团队前沿研究与工业实践，提供完整技术框架与路线图，配套教学课件。适合具深度学习基础的读者入门大模型技术，可作为高校课程与行业研发权威参考。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically presents the comprehensive technical framework of Large Language Models, covering fundamental aspects including pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and prompt engineering. Based on the authors' pioneering research and practical industrial experience in developing models like Wenlan and Yulan, it offers a structured learning roadmap with supplementary lecture slides. Aimed at readers with foundational deep learning knowledge, this authoritative volume serves as an essential reference for both academic courses and industrial R&D in LLM technology, bridging theoretical concepts with real-world implementation.

repos.description: 😎 🔗 Awesome list about all kinds of resources for learning Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一份精心整理的网络安全学习资源大全，专为渗透测试和道德黑客入门者设计。收录从基础书籍到实战平台的完整体系，涵盖CTF挑战、漏洞实验室、恶意软件分析等核心领域。通过Hack The Box、TryHackMe等在线靶场，学习者可获真实渗透测试经验。项目强调实践导向，包含OSCP风格实验和权限提升专项训练，是构建网络安全知识体系的权威参考资料。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of comprehensive resources for learning ethical hacking and penetration testing. It covers foundational books, hands-on CTF platforms like Hack The Box and TryHackMe, vulnerable web applications, malware analysis tools, and Linux pentesting distributions. The repository features OSCP-style labs, privilege escalation workshops, and extensive vulnerability databases. Designed for structured skill development from beginner to advanced levels, it serves as an authoritative guide for building practical cybersecurity expertise through real-world scenarios and community-driven contributions.

repos.description: Introduction to Autonomous Robots
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供MIT出版社《自主机器人导论：机制、传感器、执行器与算法》教材的LaTeX源代码。该书聚焦自主机器人计算原理，涵盖机制、传感器、执行器和算法。采用CC-BY-NC-ND许可，允许非商业教学用途并需署名。可通过LaTeX或Overleaf编译PDF，印刷版见亚马逊。是机器人教育与研究的重要资源。
repos.summary_en: The repository provides the LaTeX source for the MIT Press textbook 'Introduction to Autonomous Robots: Mechanisms, Sensors, Actuators, and Algorithms'. It focuses on the computational principles of autonomous robots, covering mechanisms, sensors, actuators, and algorithms. Licensed under CC-BY-NC-ND for non-commercial use like teaching with attribution. Users can compile the PDF via LaTeX or Overleaf; print edition available on Amazon. An essential resource for robotics education and research.

repos.description: AI reads books: Page-by-Page PDF Knowledge Extractor & Summarizer. script performs an intelligent page-by-page analysis of PDF books, methodically extracting knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at specified intervals
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过AI逐页解析PDF书籍，自动提取核心知识点并生成渐进式摘要。支持智能过滤目录/索引页，具备断点续处理与Markdown结构化输出能力。适用于个人深度学习、研究资料整理与知识库构建，实现从海量书籍中高效提炼结构化知识，提升阅读效率与知识内化效果。
repos.summary_en: This tool performs AI-powered page-by-page analysis of PDF books, automatically extracting key knowledge points and generating progressive summaries at configurable intervals. Featuring intelligent filtering of TOC/index pages, resume capability, and structured Markdown output, it maintains contextual flow while processing. Ideal for deep learning, research material processing, and knowledge base construction, it efficiently transforms massive books into structured knowledge, significantly improving reading efficiency and knowledge internalization through systematic analysis.

repos.description: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

repos.description: 将被语言阻隔的作品，带到读者的语言中。Bringing literature into your language.
repos.summary_zh: 文译（wenyi）是专注于多语言小说翻译成中文的AI工具，支持EPUB/FB2/TXT输入并保留原排版、图片、目录和链接。采用多档LLM（strong/cheap/fast）驱动的流水线，包括全书预扫、术语库管理、滚动上下文、润色、章末审校和一致性QA，确保长文本翻译准确连贯。提供CLI断点续传功能，适合个人或小团队实现外国文学的自动化本地化。
repos.summary_en: Wenyi is an AI-powered tool for translating multilingual novels from EPUB, FB2 or TXT into Chinese while preserving original formatting, images, TOC and links. It uses a multi-tier LLM pipeline (strong/cheap/fast) with book pre-scan, glossary management, rolling context, polishing, chapter review and consistency QA for accurate long-form translations. Features CLI with resumable processing, ideal for efficient localization of foreign literature.

repos.description: A Calibre plugin to translate ebook into a specified language.
repos.summary_zh: Bookfere Ebook Translator 是为 Calibre 设计的专业翻译插件，集成 Google、DeepL、ChatGPT 等主流引擎及自定义 API 支持。插件全面兼容 Calibre 48 种输入格式，提供高级与批量双模式，支持多任务并行翻译与智能缓存，可无缝集成至 Calibre 库管理，是跨语言阅读与电子书本地化的技术解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Bookfere Ebook Translator is a professional Calibre plugin integrating Google Translate, DeepL, ChatGPT, Gemini, and custom APIs to translate ebooks across 48 input formats. It offers advanced and batch modes, parallel processing, intelligent caching, and seamless Calibre library integration, delivering a robust solution for cross-language reading and ebook localization with extensive customization options and format compatibility.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是基于Claude Code的电子书翻译工具，采用并行子代理架构实现整本书的高效翻译。支持PDF/DOCX/EPUB输入，自动分块、并行翻译、验证合并，输出多格式文档。核心技术包括8并发子代理、SHA-256清单验证和断点续传，有效解决长文本上下文溢出问题。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Claude Code-based ebook translation tool that uses parallel subagents for efficient whole-book translation. It supports PDF/DOCX/EPUB input, automatically chunking, parallel translating, validating, and merging into multiple formats. Key features include 8 concurrent subagents, SHA-256 manifest validation, and resumable runs to solve long-text context overflow.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: CSAPP 中文文档与学习资料：《深入理解计算机系统》第三版全章节 Markdown，含练习题答案、八大实验中文翻译及官方自学实验包，方便在线阅读与离线学习。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供《深入理解计算机系统》（CSAPP第三版）完整中文Markdown资料，涵盖全部12章正文、练习题与原书答案、附录及八大实验的中文说明与官方自学包。支持在线阅读网站（章节导航、全文搜索、深色模式）与本地离线使用，方便系统学习计算机底层原理、做题与实验实践。
repos.summary_en: Complete Chinese Markdown resources for CSAPP 3rd Edition, including all 12 chapters, practice problem answers, appendices, and Chinese translations of the eight official labs with self-study packages. Features an online reading site with navigation, full-text search and dark mode, plus offline Markdown for systematic study of computer systems, problem-solving and hands-on labs.

repos.description: 微信读书 koreader 插件，在 koreader 里阅读微信读书里的书籍、公众号文章，支持阅读进度同步，阅读时长上报和统计，本地书籍支持获取微信读书划线和想法内容，支持Kindle、Kobo等所有能安装 koreader 的设备。
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书 KOReader 插件，可在 Kindle、Kobo 等设备上阅读微信读书书籍与公众号文章，支持进度同步、时长统计、划线想法获取及章节预下载，打通封闭系统与微信读书生态。
repos.summary_en: KOReader plugin for WeRead on Kindle/Kobo: progress sync, reading stats, highlights, pre-download.

repos.description: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP
repos.summary_zh: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
repos.summary_en: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

repos.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
repos.summary_en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

repos.description: List of OSINT Books
repos.summary_zh: 该GitHub仓库精选开源情报（OSINT）书籍列表，聚焦工具与技术、在网络安全、招聘及人权调查等场景的应用，还涵盖调查心理层面。优先收录2020年代出版物，避免过时技术内容，包括批判性思维、AI情报分析、尽职调查、隐私保护等主题。每条目附封面、作者社交链接、年份和购买链接，为情报分析师和安全专业人士提供实用、全面的OSINT学习资源。
repos.summary_en: This GitHub repository curates a list of books on Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), covering tools, techniques, and applications in cybersecurity, recruiting, and human rights investigations, plus psychological aspects. It prioritizes 2020s publications to avoid outdated technical details, including titles on critical thinking, AI for analysts, due diligence, and privacy. Entries feature covers, author links, years, and purchase links, serving as a practical resource for intelligence professionals seeking modern OSINT methodologies.

repos.description: Read premium articles for free with this Bookmarklet
repos.summary_zh: Readium 是一个轻量级书签工具，通过 JavaScript 技术绕过付费墙限制，让用户免费访问 Medium、Substack 等平台的优质内容。项目采用 Vue.js 构建官方网站，部署于 GitHub Pages，提供一键式便捷操作。相比浏览器扩展，书签形式无需安装，更加便携高效，是数字内容自由访问的实用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Readium is a lightweight bookmarklet that bypasses paywalls to provide free access to premium content on platforms like Medium and Substack. Built with Vue.js and deployed on GitHub Pages, it offers a one-click solution without requiring browser extension installation. This portable tool leverages JavaScript to remove content restrictions, delivering a streamlined alternative to traditional ad-blockers or subscription management tools for effortless reading of gated articles. Its open-source nature ensures transparency and community-driven improvements.

repos.summary_zh: BookAlign 利用 embedding 与动态规划算法，精准对齐外语原著与正式译本的句段结构，重建成可直接对照阅读的双语 EPUB。支持段落级与句子级回写，完整保留原书目录、脚注等元素，特别适合日语小说配中文译本。可输出 JSON 对齐结果供调试，避免机翻质量风险，提升沉浸式阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: BookAlign aligns foreign language EPUB originals with official translations using embedding-based semantic matching and dynamic programming algorithms to create bilingual ebooks for comparative reading. It supports both paragraph-level and inline sentence-level writeback modes, preserving original spine order, table of contents, footnotes, and other structural elements. Optimized for Japanese-to-Chinese novel alignment, it exports alignment results as JSON for debugging, eliminating machine translation risks and the hassle of switching between multiple reading applications.
